identity.lineage: The owner's what-if of 2 Oct 2026: 217 contracted days a year at most, every other rule kept. That allows 88 Monday-to-Saturday duties, one fewer than the 219-day designs, and the owner chose to take it from Friday, the quietest day. The weeks were searched from random starts with the weekend gap capped at five (anneal.mjs), then polished twice with the restart's floors (space-polish.mjs); the second pass, pressing on single rest days, met every floor. 216.6 days a year, so it is also inside today's 219 ceiling.
